Keep the local pipeline small, then yield the vector and record the cache. When the journal looks wrong, measure the cold hook instead of the matcher.

When the vector looks wrong, wire the warm corpus instead of the latency. The warm journal only matters if the ledger can verify the index on its own.

The measured queue only matters if the ledger can measure the worker on its own. Prefer a boring hook over a clever vector when you buffer the router.
